responsibility: Implements the D front end’s PA-RISC target hooks. It registers D builtin version identifiers that reflect HPPA versus HPPA64 and soft- versus hard-float configurations, and answers D `__traits(getTargetInfo, ...)` queries for PA-specific properties such as float ABI and SOM object format, bridging GCC target flags into D language-visible target metadata.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the PA-specific D hooks: unlike pa-d.h, it contains the executable logic that computes D builtin version tags and target-info strings from target flags such as TARGET_64BIT, TARGET_SOFT_FLOAT, and TARGET_SOM.
